summary: Global/ElemTable fully decoded across all six samples. It is the serialized ADocument.m_elemTable = an `ElemTable` object (schema class index 0x05c9): payload = u16 0x05c9 class tag + u32 count + count × 40-byte fixed `ElemRec` records sorted by ElementId + u32 graveyard count (0) + 20-byte footer (0xFFFFFFFF, u16 class 0x096a, u64 last-id watermark). It is NOT an id→(partition,offset) location index: each ElemRec = ElementHistory{u64 originalElementId, u32 creation EpisodeId, u32 lastModification EpisodeId, u32 lastUserModification EpisodeId (0xFFFFFFFF=never)} + u64 m_id + u64 m_OwningElementId + u32 m_partitionId(=0), field order/names verified against the de-framed Formats/Latest schema. Critical corpus-wide finding (independently corroborates agent cross-file): raw streams are page-framed as 64,896-byte payload + 353-byte block (stride 65,249) from stream offset 0; stripping the blocks makes every gzip trailer CRC/ISIZE-valid, fixes the previously undecodable dach and rme ElemTables, and shows the old extracted .gz corpus (including the schema past ~139 KB) is corrupt. Cross-checks: record count equals the Partitions/<N> header u32 at bytes 14–17 in all six files; max lastModification EpisodeId + 1 equals the Global/History episode count in all six files; payload size = 6+40N+24 byte-exact everywhere.
key_findings: Global/ElemTable payload = [u16 0x05c9 (ElemTable class index)][u32 count][count × 40-byte ElemRec, strictly sorted by m_id][u32 graveyard count = 0][20-byte footer: u32 0xFFFFFFFF, u16 0x096a class tag [hypothesis], u16 0, u64 id watermark, u32 0]; size = 6 + 40·count + 24 byte-exact in all six files (racbasic 8,401 recs / 336,070 B; dach 49,776 / 1,991,070 B).

ElemRec 40-byte layout (LE), matching schema field order ElemRec{m_history, m_id, m_OwningElementId, m_partitionId} with ElementHistory inlined: +0 u64 m_originalElementId, +8 u32 m_creationDate (EpisodeId), +12 u32 m_lastModificationDate (EpisodeId), +16 u32 m_lastUserModificationDate (EpisodeId, 0xFFFFFFFF = never), +20 u64 m_id (ElementId, sort key), +28 u64 m_OwningElementId (-1 = none; 31-65% have an owner), +36 u32 m_partitionId (0 in all 128,331 records).

The table is a version/existence index, not a byte-offset location table: the three u32s are episode (save-version) numbers indexing Global/History's episode list — in all six files episode count (u32 at inflated History offset 14) == max(m_lastModificationDate)+1, and invariants creation ≤ userMod ≤ lastMod and originalElementId ≤ m_id hold for every record.

CORPUS-WIDE (corroborates agent cross-file): every raw stream is page-framed with stride 65,249 = 64,896 payload bytes + 353-byte non-payload block, counted from stream offset 0; after removing the blocks every gzip member ends with a VALID CRC32/ISIZE trailer. KNOWLEDGE.md's 'corrupt trailer / trailing junk' is an artifact, and the current extracted/*.gz corpus (including Formats/Latest past ~139 KB inflated, true size 496,597 B) is corrupt for any stream > 64,896 B.

dach and rme ElemTables, which cannot inflate as extracted (zlib 'invalid block type' / 'invalid code lengths set'), decode cleanly (CRC-valid) once de-framed: dach 296,563 B raw with gaps at 64,896/130,145/195,394/260,643 → 1,991,070 B; rme 151,224 B raw with gaps at 64,896/130,145 → 1,125,310 B.

Cross-stream hooks: Partitions/<N> stream header u32 at bytes 14-17 equals the ElemTable record count in all six files (header shape `09000000 00000000 a3030000 0000 <u32 count> 280f0400 ...`); dach's Partitions/85 has count 0.

Schema class-index mechanics recovered from the de-framed schema: type refs `0e <flags> 00 00 <u16 class>` (flag 0x50 = array, 0x14 = ElementId u64); high bit 0x8000 on the class = inline first-use definition (GraveyardRec `ca 85` = 0x05ca, ElementHistory `a5 83` = 0x03a5, PartitionId `8f 85` = 0x058f); ElemRec = 0x05c5 hence ElemTable = 0x05c9 = the stream's leading u16.
Worksharing: in dach, 1,476 records have m_originalElementId != m_id (elements renumbered on sync); the table sorts by the current m_id, not the original id.
confidence: High. Container/framing, header, record layout, sizes and field names are byte-exact and CRC-verified across all six files with two independent cross-checks (Partitions header count, History episode count). Medium/hypothesis only for footer field meanings (0x096a class tag, id watermark), the 8-byte zero stream prefix, the 353-byte page-block content, and the per-element-class semantics of m_OwningElementId.
